        self.write_json("harnesses/codex/catalog.json", self.catalog())
        check = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "--repo-root", str(self.root), "--check"],
            check=False,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
        )
        self.assertEqual(check.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("out of date", check.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.build().returncode, 0)
        checked = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "--repo-root", str(self.root), "--check"],
            check=False,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,

    def test_check_fails_for_a_stale_root_discovery_manifest(self) -> None:
        self.write_json("harnesses/codex/catalog.json", self.catalog())
        self.assertEqual(self.build().returncode, 0)
        self.write(".agents/plugins/marketplace.json", "{}\n")

        check = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(BUILDER), "--repo-root", str(self.root), "--check"],
            check=False,
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
        )

        self.assertEqual(check.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("out of date", check.stderr)
        result = self.build()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        discovery = json.loads((self.root / ".agents/plugins/marketplace.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(discovery["plugins"][0]["source"]["path"], "./dist/codex/plugins/bravo")

    def test_root_discovery_write_failure_restores_the_previous_bundle(self) -> None:
        self.write_json("harnesses/codex/catalog.json", self.catalog())
        self.assertEqual(self.build().returncode, 0)
        output = self.root / "dist/codex"
        before = self.files(output)
        discovery = self.root / ".agents/plugins/marketplace.json"
        discovery.unlink()
        discovery.mkdir()

        result = self.build()

        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
        self.assertEqual(self.files(output), before)
        self.assertFalse(any((self.root / "dist").glob(".codex.previous-*")))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Verify the portable lifecycle fixture against Claude source and Codex output."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


REPOSITORY_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FIXTURE_PATH = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "tests/fixtures/cross-harness/lifecycle.json"


def read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Read a JSON object from a repository-controlled file."""
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise AssertionError(f"{path} must contain a JSON object")
    return value


def validate_subset(instance: Any, schema: dict[str, Any], path: str = "$") -> list[str]:
    """Validate the JSON-Schema features used by the lifecycle fixture."""
    errors: list[str] = []
    expected_type = schema.get("type")
    type_matches = {
        "object": lambda value: isinstance(value, dict),
        "array": lambda value: isinstance(value, list),
        "string": lambda value: isinstance(value, str),
        "boolean": lambda value: isinstance(value, bool),
        "integer": lambda value: isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool),
    }
    if expected_type in type_matches and not type_matches[expected_type](instance):
        return [f"{path}: expected {expected_type}"]

    if "enum" in schema and instance not in schema["enum"]:
        errors.append(f"{path}: expected one of {schema['enum']!r}")
    if "const" in schema and instance != schema["const"]:
        errors.append(f"{path}: expected {schema['const']!r}")
    forbidden = schema.get("not")
    if isinstance(forbidden, dict) and not validate_subset(instance, forbidden, path):
        errors.append(f"{path}: matched a forbidden shape")
    if isinstance(instance, str):
        minimum_length = schema.get("minLength")
        if isinstance(minimum_length, int) and len(instance) < minimum_length:
            errors.append(f"{path}: expected at least {minimum_length} characters")
    if isinstance(instance, int) and not isinstance(instance, bool):
        minimum = schema.get("minimum")
        if isinstance(minimum, int) and instance < minimum:
            errors.append(f"{path}: expected at least {minimum}")

    if isinstance(instance, dict):
        properties = schema.get("properties", {})
        for name in schema.get("required", []):
            if name not in instance:
                errors.append(f"{path}: missing required property {name!r}")
        if schema.get("additionalProperties") is False:
            for name in instance:
                if name not in properties:
                    errors.append(f"{path}: unexpected property {name!r}")
        for name, value in instance.items():
            child_schema = properties.get(name)
            if isinstance(child_schema, dict):
                errors.extend(validate_subset(value, child_schema, f"{path}.{name}"))

    if isinstance(instance, list):
        minimum = schema.get("minItems")
        if isinstance(minimum, int) and len(instance) < minimum:
            errors.append(f"{path}: expected at least {minimum} items")
        maximum = schema.get("maxItems")
        if isinstance(maximum, int) and len(instance) > maximum:
            errors.append(f"{path}: expected at most {maximum} items")
        item_schema = schema.get("items")
        if isinstance(item_schema, dict):
            for index, value in enumerate(instance):
                errors.extend(validate_subset(value, item_schema, f"{path}[{index}]"))
        contains = schema.get("contains")
        if isinstance(contains, dict) and not any(
            not validate_subset(value, contains, f"{path}[{index}]") for index, value in enumerate(instance)
        ):
            errors.append(f"{path}: no item matched the required shape")

    for constraint in schema.get("allOf", []):
        errors.extend(validate_subset(instance, constraint, path))

    condition = schema.get("if")
    if isinstance(condition, dict):
        branch = schema.get("then") if not validate_subset(instance, condition, path) else schema.get("else")
        if isinstance(branch, dict):
            errors.extend(validate_subset(instance, branch, path))
    return errors


class CrossHarnessArtifactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        fixture = read_json(FIXTURE_PATH)
        cls.stages = fixture["stages"]

    def test_fixture_documents_validate_against_portable_contracts(self) -> None:
        for stage in self.stages:
            artifact = stage["artifact"]
            source_schema = read_json(REPOSITORY_ROOT / "shared/schemas" / f"{artifact}.json")
            errors = validate_subset(stage["document"], source_schema)
            self.assertEqual(errors, [], f"{artifact} fixture is invalid: {errors}")

    def test_codex_materializes_the_same_contract_bytes_for_each_handoff(self) -> None:
        for stage in self.stages:
            artifact = stage["artifact"]
            source = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "shared/schemas" / f"{artifact}.json"
            for role in ("producer", "consumer"):
                plugin = stage[role]["plugin"]
                materialized = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "dist/codex/plugins" / plugin / "shared/schemas" / f"{artifact}.json"
                self.assertTrue(materialized.is_file(), f"{plugin} is missing {artifact}")
                self.assertFalse(materialized.is_symlink(), f"{plugin} ships {artifact} as a symlink")
                self.assertEqual(materialized.read_bytes(), source.read_bytes(), f"{plugin} changed {artifact}")

    def test_each_fixture_handoff_is_declared_by_both_harnesses(self) -> None:
        for stage in self.stages:
            artifact = stage["artifact"]
            producer = stage["producer"]
            consumer = stage["consumer"]
            producer_manifest = read_json(REPOSITORY_ROOT / "plugins" / producer["plugin"] / "plugin.json")
            consumer_manifest = read_json(REPOSITORY_ROOT / "plugins" / consumer["plugin"] / "plugin.json")
            self.assertIn(artifact, producer_manifest["produces"])
            self.assertIn(artifact, consumer_manifest["consumes"])

            codex_producer = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "dist/codex/plugins" / producer["plugin"] / "skills" / producer["skill"] / "SKILL.md"
            codex_consumer = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "dist/codex/plugins" / consumer["plugin"] / "skills" / consumer["skill"] / "SKILL.md"
            self.assertIn(artifact, codex_producer.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            self.assertIn(artifact, codex_consumer.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import re
6	import unittest
7	from pathlib import Path
8	from urllib.parse import unquote
9	
10	
11	REPOSITORY_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
12	REFERENCE_ROOT = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "shared/references"
13	REFERENCE_PATH = re.compile(r"shared/references/[A-Za-z0-9@._/-]+\.md")
14	SCHEMA_PATH = re.compile(r"shared/schemas/[A-Za-z0-9@._/-]+\.json")
15	MARKDOWN_LINK = re.compile(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)")
16	REFERENCE_LINK = re.compile(r"^\s*\[[^\]]+\]:\s+(\S+)", re.MULTILINE)
17	HTML_LINK = re.compile(r"(?:href|src)=[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']")
18	RETIRED_REFERENCE_NAME = re.compile(
19	    r"(?:\*|rust|typescript|python|go)-hazards(?:-t7-t10)?\.md|(?<!/)changesets\.md"
20	)
21	TEXT_SUFFIXES = {".json", ".md", ".py", ".sh", ".yaml", ".yml"}
22	EXCLUDED_PARTS = {".git", ".agents", "dist", "node_modules"}
23	AUTHORING_ONLY = {
24	    "shared/references/README.md",
25	    "shared/references/authoring/diagrams.md",
26	    "shared/references/tooling/cli.md",
27	}
28	CONCERN_DIRECTORIES = {
29	    "architecture",
30	    "authoring",
31	    "delivery",
32	    "evaluation",
33	    "hazards",
34	    "tooling",
35	    "verification",
36	    "workspace",
37	}
38	# Published schemas are byte-immutable. Keep narrow exceptions for exact paths
39	# embedded before a reference move; live skill and agent routes must still use
40	# current paths and pass the checks below.
41	IMMUTABLE_PATH_EXCEPTIONS = {
42	    (
43	        "shared/schemas/changeset@2.json",
44	        "shared/references/" "changesets" ".md",
45	    ): "shared/references/delivery/changesets.md",
46	}
47	
48	
49	def authored_text_files() -> list[Path]:
50	    return [
51	        path
52	        for path in REPOSITORY_ROOT.rglob("*")
53	        if path.is_file()
54	        and path.suffix in TEXT_SUFFIXES
55	        and path.name != "CHANGELOG.md"
56	        and not EXCLUDED_PARTS.intersection(path.relative_to(REPOSITORY_ROOT).parts)
57	    ]
58	
59	
60	def is_runtime_caller(path: Path) -> bool:
61	    relative = path.relative_to(REPOSITORY_ROOT)
62	    parts = relative.parts
63	    if parts[:2] == ("shared", "references"):
64	        return path != REFERENCE_ROOT / "README.md"
65	    if parts[:2] == ("shared", "hooks"):
66	        return True
67	    if parts and parts[0] == "plugins":
68	        return "agents" in parts or "skills" in parts
69	    return parts[:3] == ("harnesses", "codex", "plugins") and "skills" in parts
70	
71	
72	def local_markdown_target(raw_target: str) -> str | None:
73	    target = raw_target.strip()
74	    if target.startswith("<") and ">" in target:
75	        target = target[1 : target.index(">")]
76	    else:
77	        target = target.split(maxsplit=1)[0]
78	    if not target or target.startswith("#") or "://" in target or target.startswith("mailto:"):
79	        return None
80	    return unquote(target.split("#", 1)[0].split("?", 1)[0])
81	
82	
83	class ReferenceIntegrityTests(unittest.TestCase):
84	    @classmethod
85	    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
86	        cls.sources = {
87	            path: path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
88	            for path in authored_text_files()
89	        }
90	
91	    def test_exact_reference_paths_exist(self) -> None:
92	        broken: list[str] = []
93	        for source, contents in self.sources.items():
94	            for reference in REFERENCE_PATH.findall(contents):
95	                source_name = source.relative_to(REPOSITORY_ROOT).as_posix()
96	                if (source_name, reference) in IMMUTABLE_PATH_EXCEPTIONS:
97	                    continue
98	                if not (REPOSITORY_ROOT / reference).is_file():
99	                    broken.append(f"{source_name} -> {reference}")
100	        self.assertEqual(broken, [])
101	
102	    def test_exact_schema_paths_exist(self) -> None:
103	        broken = [
104	            f"{source.relative_to(REPOSITORY_ROOT).as_posix()} -> {schema}"
105	            for source, contents in self.sources.items()
106	            if source.suffix in {".json", ".md", ".yaml", ".yml"}
107	            for schema in SCHEMA_PATH.findall(contents)
108	            if not (REPOSITORY_ROOT / schema).is_file()
109	        ]
110	        self.assertEqual(broken, [])
111	
112	    def test_immutable_path_exceptions_have_live_replacements(self) -> None:
113	        invalid: list[str] = []
114	        for (source_name, historical), replacement in IMMUTABLE_PATH_EXCEPTIONS.items():
115	            source = REPOSITORY_ROOT / source_name
116	            if historical not in source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"):
117	                invalid.append(f"{source_name} no longer contains {historical}")
118	            if not (REPOSITORY_ROOT / replacement).is_file():
119	                invalid.append(f"replacement missing: {replacement}")
120	            live_callers = [
121	                path.relative_to(REPOSITORY_ROOT).as_posix()
122	                for path, contents in self.sources.items()
123	                if path != source and is_runtime_caller(path) and historical in contents
124	            ]
125	            if live_callers:
126	                invalid.append(f"live callers still use {historical}: {live_callers}")
127	        self.assertEqual(invalid, [])
128	
129	    def test_local_markdown_links_resolve(self) -> None:
130	        broken: list[str] = []
131	        for source, contents in self.sources.items():
132	            if source.suffix != ".md":
133	                continue
134	            raw_targets = (
135	                MARKDOWN_LINK.findall(contents)
136	                + REFERENCE_LINK.findall(contents)
137	                + HTML_LINK.findall(contents)
138	            )
139	            for raw_target in raw_targets:
140	                target = local_markdown_target(raw_target)
141	                if target is None:
142	                    continue
143	                resolved = (source.parent / target).resolve()
144	                if not resolved.exists():
145	                    source_name = source.relative_to(REPOSITORY_ROOT).as_posix()
146	                    broken.append(f"{source_name} -> {target}")
147	        self.assertEqual(broken, [])
148	
149	    def test_retired_or_ambiguous_reference_names_are_absent(self) -> None:
150	        stale = [
151	            f"{source.relative_to(REPOSITORY_ROOT).as_posix()} -> {match.group(0)}"
152	            for source, contents in self.sources.items()
153	            for match in RETIRED_REFERENCE_NAME.finditer(contents)
154	        ]
155	        self.assertEqual(stale, [])
156	
157	    def test_reference_paths_are_concern_first(self) -> None:
158	        misplaced = [
159	            path.relative_to(REFERENCE_ROOT).as_posix()
160	            for path in REFERENCE_ROOT.rglob("*.md")
161	            if path != REFERENCE_ROOT / "README.md"
162	            and path.relative_to(REFERENCE_ROOT).parts[0] not in CONCERN_DIRECTORIES
163	        ]
164	        self.assertEqual(misplaced, [])
165	
166	    def test_each_runtime_reference_has_a_runtime_caller(self) -> None:
167	        missing: list[str] = []
168	        for reference_file in REFERENCE_ROOT.rglob("*.md"):
169	            reference = reference_file.relative_to(REPOSITORY_ROOT).as_posix()
170	            if reference in AUTHORING_ONLY:
171	                continue
172	            callers = [
173	                source
174	                for source, contents in self.sources.items()
175	                if source != reference_file and is_runtime_caller(source) and reference in contents
176	            ]
177	            if not callers:
178	                missing.append(reference)
179	        self.assertEqual(missing, [])
180	
181	    def test_adr_index_matches_records(self) -> None:
182	        index = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "docs/adr/README.md"
183	        rows: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
184	        problems: list[str] = []
185	        for line in index.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
186	            if not line.startswith("| ["):
187	                continue
188	            cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.strip("|").split("|")]
189	            if len(cells) != 5 or not cells[4].startswith("Do not "):
190	                problems.append(f"malformed row: {line[:40]}")
191	                continue
192	            rows[cells[0][1:4]] = cells
193	        records = {record.name[:3]: record for record in index.parent.glob("[0-9][0-9][0-9]-*.md")}
194	        self.assertEqual(sorted(rows), sorted(records))
195	        for number, record in records.items():
196	            _, status, _, relation, _ = rows[number]
197	            meta = [
198	                line
199	                for line in record.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
200	                if re.match(r"\*\*(Status|Supersedes|Extended by):\*\*", line)
201	            ]
202	            superseded = any("superseded" in line.lower() for line in meta if line.startswith("**Status:"))
203	            if status not in {"Accepted", "Partially superseded", "Superseded"} or superseded == (status == "Accepted"):
204	                problems.append(f"{number}: index status {status!r} disagrees with the record")
205	            for other in re.findall(r"ADR-(\d{3})", " ".join(meta)):
206	                if other not in rows or other not in relation:
207	                    problems.append(f"{number}: Relation omits or misnames {other}")
208	        self.assertEqual(problems, [])

24	def validate_subset(instance: Any, schema: dict[str, Any], path: str = "$") -> list[str]:
25	    """Validate the JSON-Schema features used by the lifecycle fixture."""
26	    errors: list[str] = []
27	    expected_type = schema.get("type")
28	    type_matches = {
29	        "object": lambda value: isinstance(value, dict),
30	        "array": lambda value: isinstance(value, list),
31	        "string": lambda value: isinstance(value, str),
32	        "boolean": lambda value: isinstance(value, bool),
33	        "integer": lambda value: isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool),
34	    }
35	    if expected_type in type_matches and not type_matches[expected_type](instance):
36	        return [f"{path}: expected {expected_type}"]
37	
38	    if "enum" in schema and instance not in schema["enum"]:
39	        errors.append(f"{path}: expected one of {schema['enum']!r}")
40	    if "const" in schema and instance != schema["const"]:
41	        errors.append(f"{path}: expected {schema['const']!r}")
42	    forbidden = schema.get("not")
43	    if isinstance(forbidden, dict) and not validate_subset(instance, forbidden, path):
44	        errors.append(f"{path}: matched a forbidden shape")
45	    if isinstance(instance, str):
46	        minimum_length = schema.get("minLength")
47	        if isinstance(minimum_length, int) and len(instance) < minimum_length:
48	            errors.append(f"{path}: expected at least {minimum_length} characters")
49	    if isinstance(instance, int) and not isinstance(instance, bool):
50	        minimum = schema.get("minimum")
51	        if isinstance(minimum, int) and instance < minimum:
52	            errors.append(f"{path}: expected at least {minimum}")
53	
54	    if isinstance(instance, dict):
55	        properties = schema.get("properties", {})
56	        for name in schema.get("required", []):
57	            if name not in instance:
58	                errors.append(f"{path}: missing required property {name!r}")
59	        if schema.get("additionalProperties") is False:
60	            for name in instance:
61	                if name not in properties:
62	                    errors.append(f"{path}: unexpected property {name!r}")
63	        for name, value in instance.items():
64	            child_schema = properties.get(name)
65	            if isinstance(child_schema, dict):
66	                errors.extend(validate_subset(value, child_schema, f"{path}.{name}"))
67	
68	    if isinstance(instance, list):
69	        minimum = schema.get("minItems")
70	        if isinstance(minimum, int) and len(instance) < minimum:
71	            errors.append(f"{path}: expected at least {minimum} items")
72	        maximum = schema.get("maxItems")
73	        if isinstance(maximum, int) and len(instance) > maximum:
74	            errors.append(f"{path}: expected at most {maximum} items")
75	        item_schema = schema.get("items")
76	        if isinstance(item_schema, dict):
77	            for index, value in enumerate(instance):
78	                errors.extend(validate_subset(value, item_schema, f"{path}[{index}]"))
79	        contains = schema.get("contains")
80	        if isinstance(contains, dict) and not any(
81	            not validate_subset(value, contains, f"{path}[{index}]") for index, value in enumerate(instance)
82	        ):
83	            errors.append(f"{path}: no item matched the required shape")
84	
85	    for constraint in schema.get("allOf", []):
86	        errors.extend(validate_subset(instance, constraint, path))
87	
88	    condition = schema.get("if")
89	    if isinstance(condition, dict):
90	        branch = schema.get("then") if not validate_subset(instance, condition, path) else schema.get("else")
91	        if isinstance(branch, dict):
92	            errors.extend(validate_subset(instance, branch, path))
93	    return errors

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Block commits that violate generated-output or schema-version invariants."""
3	
4	from __future__ import annotations
5	
6	import json
7	import re
8	import subprocess
9	import sys
10	from pathlib import Path
11	from typing import Any
12	
13	
14	COMMIT_COMMAND = re.compile(r"(?:^|[;&|]\s*)git(?:\s+-[A-Za-z]\s+[^\s;&|]+)*\s+commit(?:\s|$)")
15	REPOSITORY_MARKERS = ("marketplace.json", "shared/constitution.md", "tools/build-codex-marketplace.py")
16	
17	
18	def emit_block(reason: str) -> None:
19	    print(json.dumps({"decision": "block", "reason": reason}))
20	
21	
22	def repository_root(cwd: str) -> Path | None:
23	    try:
24	        result = subprocess.run(
25	            ["git", "-C", cwd, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"],
26	            check=True,
27	            capture_output=True,
28	            text=True,
29	        )
30	    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
31	        return None
32	    root = Path(result.stdout.strip())
33	    if all((root / marker).is_file() for marker in REPOSITORY_MARKERS):
34	        return root
35	    return None
36	
37	
38	def is_commit_command(command: str) -> bool:
39	    return bool(COMMIT_COMMAND.search(command))
40	
41	
42	def staged_schema_mutations(root: Path) -> list[str]:
43	    result = subprocess.run(
44	        ["git", "-C", str(root), "diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "--", "shared/schemas"],
45	        check=True,
46	        capture_output=True,
47	        text=True,
48	    )
49	    return [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line and not line.startswith("A\t")]
50	
51	
52	def generated_bundle_is_current(root: Path) -> bool:
53	    result = subprocess.run(
54	        [sys.executable, "tools/build-codex-marketplace.py", "--check"],
55	        cwd=root,
56	        capture_output=True,
57	        text=True,
58	    )
59	    return result.returncode == 0
60	
61	
62	def evaluate(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
63	    tool_name = payload.get("tool_name")
64	    tool_input = payload.get("tool_input")
65	    if tool_name != "Bash" or not isinstance(tool_input, dict):
66	        return None
67	    command = tool_input.get("command")
68	    cwd = payload.get("cwd")
69	    if not isinstance(command, str) or not is_commit_command(command) or not isinstance(cwd, str):
70	        return None
71	    root = repository_root(cwd)
72	    if root is None:
73	        return None
74	    mutations = staged_schema_mutations(root)
75	    if mutations:
76	        changed = ", ".join(mutations)
77	        return f"Tracked schema versions are immutable. Add a new shared/schemas/<name>@<N+1>.json instead of committing: {changed}"
78	    if not generated_bundle_is_current(root):
79	        return "The generated Codex marketplace is stale. Run python3 tools/build-codex-marketplace.py, review dist/codex, then commit."
80	    return None
81	
82	
83	def main() -> int:
84	    try:
85	        payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
86	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
87	        return 0
88	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
89	        return 0
90	    reason = evaluate(payload)
91	    if reason:
92	        emit_block(reason)
93	    return 0
94	
95	
96	if __name__ == "__main__":
97	    raise SystemExit(main())

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# For each plugin, checks that plugin.json's version, the README's
3	# **Version:** line, the CHANGELOG's top entry, and marketplace.json's
4	# per-plugin version all agree. These four are updated by hand on every
5	# bump and have drifted before (fixed across 4 plugins in v3.1.0) —
6	# nothing structural stopped it from happening again.
7	#
8	# Usage: scripts/check-versions.sh
9	
10	set -euo pipefail
11	script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
12	# shellcheck source=lib/report.sh
13	source "$script_dir/lib/report.sh"
14	cd "$script_dir/.."
15	
16	fail=0
17	count=0
18	
19	for plugin_json in plugins/*/plugin.json; do
20	  dir="$(dirname "$plugin_json")"
21	  id="$(basename "$dir")"
22	  count=$((count + 1))
23	
24	  pj_version="$(jq -r '.version' "$plugin_json")"
25	  readme_version="$(grep -oE '\*\*Version:\*\* *[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$dir/README.md" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
26	  changelog_version="$(grep -oE '^## \[[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$dir/CHANGELOG.md" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
27	  marketplace_version="$(jq -r --arg id "$id" '.plugins[] | select(.id == $id) | .version' marketplace.json)"
28	
29	  mismatches=()
30	  [[ -z "$readme_version" ]] && mismatches+=("README: no **Version:** line found")
31	  [[ -n "$readme_version" && "$readme_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("README says $readme_version")
32	  [[ -z "$changelog_version" ]] && mismatches+=("CHANGELOG: no ## [x.y.z] entry found")
33	  [[ -n "$changelog_version" && "$changelog_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("CHANGELOG says $changelog_version")
34	  [[ -z "$marketplace_version" ]] && mismatches+=("marketplace.json: no entry for id \"$id\"")
35	  [[ -n "$marketplace_version" && "$marketplace_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("marketplace.json says $marketplace_version")
36	
37	  if [[ ${#mismatches[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
38	    fail=$((fail + 1))
39	    echo "FAIL: $id (plugin.json: $pj_version)"
40	    for m in "${mismatches[@]}"; do
41	      echo "    $m"
42	    done
43	  fi
44	done
45	
46	report_check "$fail" "$count" \
47	  "plugin(s), all versions agree across plugin.json/README/CHANGELOG/marketplace.json." \
48	  "plugin(s) have version drift. Fix and re-run."
49	
50	# The ecosystem-level version has the same drift risk as a plugin's, and the

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# For each plugin, checks that plugin.json's version, the README's
# **Version:** line, the CHANGELOG's top entry, and marketplace.json's
# per-plugin version all agree. These four are updated by hand on every
# bump and have drifted before (fixed across 4 plugins in v3.1.0) —
# nothing structural stopped it from happening again.
#
# Usage: scripts/check-versions.sh

set -euo pipefail
script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
# shellcheck source=lib/report.sh
source "$script_dir/lib/report.sh"
cd "$script_dir/.."

fail=0
count=0

for plugin_json in plugins/*/plugin.json; do
  dir="$(dirname "$plugin_json")"
  id="$(basename "$dir")"
  count=$((count + 1))

  pj_version="$(jq -r '.version' "$plugin_json")"
  readme_version="$(grep -oE '\*\*Version:\*\* *[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$dir/README.md" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
  changelog_version="$(grep -oE '^## \[[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$dir/CHANGELOG.md" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
  marketplace_version="$(jq -r --arg id "$id" '.plugins[] | select(.id == $id) | .version' marketplace.json)"

  mismatches=()
  [[ -z "$readme_version" ]] && mismatches+=("README: no **Version:** line found")
  [[ -n "$readme_version" && "$readme_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("README says $readme_version")
  [[ -z "$changelog_version" ]] && mismatches+=("CHANGELOG: no ## [x.y.z] entry found")
  [[ -n "$changelog_version" && "$changelog_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("CHANGELOG says $changelog_version")
  [[ -z "$marketplace_version" ]] && mismatches+=("marketplace.json: no entry for id \"$id\"")
  [[ -n "$marketplace_version" && "$marketplace_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("marketplace.json says $marketplace_version")

  if [[ ${#mismatches[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    fail=$((fail + 1))
    echo "FAIL: $id (plugin.json: $pj_version)"
    for m in "${mismatches[@]}"; do
      echo "    $m"
    done
  fi
done

report_check "$fail" "$count" \
  "plugin(s), all versions agree across plugin.json/README/CHANGELOG/marketplace.json." \
  "plugin(s) have version drift. Fix and re-run."

# The ecosystem-level version has the same drift risk as a plugin's, and the
# same nothing structural stopped it: marketplace.json's top-level .version
# sat two releases ahead of the root CHANGELOG.md and README badge before
# this check existed.
root_version="$(jq -r '.version' marketplace.json)"
root_changelog_version="$(grep -oE '^## \[[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' CHANGELOG.md | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
root_badge_version="$(grep -oE 'Marketplace-v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' README.md | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"

root_mismatches=()
[[ -z "$root_changelog_version" ]] && root_mismatches+=("CHANGELOG.md: no ## [x.y.z] entry found")
[[ -n "$root_changelog_version" && "$root_changelog_version" != "$root_version" ]] && root_mismatches+=("CHANGELOG.md says $root_changelog_version")
[[ -z "$root_badge_version" ]] && root_mismatches+=("README.md: no Marketplace badge found")
[[ -n "$root_badge_version" && "$root_badge_version" != "$root_version" ]] && root_mismatches+=("README.md badge says $root_badge_version")

root_fail=0
if [[ ${#root_mismatches[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  root_fail=1
  echo "FAIL: ecosystem version (marketplace.json: $root_version)"
  for m in "${root_mismatches[@]}"; do
    echo "    $m"
  done
fi

report_check "$root_fail" 1 \
  "ecosystem version agrees across marketplace.json/CHANGELOG.md/README.md." \
  "ecosystem version has drift. Fix and re-run."

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Enforces constitution.md's Progressive Context Loading rule: a reference
# file covering mixed concerns must be split before publishing. The hard
# 120-line cap catches structural sprawl; the word-count warning catches
# dense one-line prose without turning length into an automatic failure.
# Checks canonical shared/references/ only; plugin shared paths link here.
#
# Usage: scripts/check-reference-size.sh

set -euo pipefail
script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
# shellcheck source=lib/report.sh
source "$script_dir/lib/report.sh"
cd "$script_dir/.."

cap=120
word_review=800
fail=0
count=0
warnings=0

while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  count=$((count + 1))
  lines=$(wc -l < "$file" | tr -d ' ')
  if [[ "$lines" -gt "$cap" ]]; then
    fail=$((fail + 1))
    echo "FAIL: $file ($lines lines, cap is $cap) — split by concern"
  fi
  words=$(wc -w < "$file" | tr -d ' ')
  if [[ "$words" -gt "$word_review" ]]; then
    warnings=$((warnings + 1))
    echo "WARN: $file ($words words) — review for mixed concerns, repetition, and removable examples"
  fi
done < <(find shared/references -name '*.md' -print0)

if [[ "$warnings" -gt 0 ]]; then
  echo "WARN: $warnings reference file(s) crossed the review signal; this does not fail validation."
fi

report_check "$fail" "$count" \
  "reference file(s) in shared/references/, all at or under the ${cap}-line cap." \
  "reference file(s) exceed the ${cap}-line cap. Split by concern and re-run."

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Shared OK/FAILED summary for scripts/check-*.sh — keeps their output in
# one consistent shape instead of each script reimplementing it.
#
# Usage: report_check <fail_count> <total_count> <ok_suffix> <fail_suffix>
#   report_check "$fail" "$count" \
#     "plugin(s), all versions agree." \
#     "plugin(s) have version drift. Fix and re-run."
# Prints "OK: $count $ok_suffix" and returns 0, or prints
# "FAILED: $fail of $count $fail_suffix" and exits 1.

report_check() {
  local fail="$1" count="$2" ok_suffix="$3" fail_suffix="$4"
  echo ""
  if [[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "OK: $count $ok_suffix"
  else
    echo "FAILED: $fail of $count $fail_suffix"
    exit 1
  fi
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Materialize the repository's authored Codex marketplace.
3	
4	Codex behavior is authored in ``harnesses/codex/plugins/<id>/``.  The builder
5	copies those native plugin trees into ``dist/codex`` without rewriting manifests
6	or skills. It also emits the repository-root discovery manifest at
7	``.agents/plugins/marketplace.json``; that manifest points at the generated
8	bundle for Git marketplace installation. ``harnesses/codex/catalog.json``
9	controls marketplace identity, order, and portable runtime files only. Its
10	supported shape is::
11	
12	    {
13	      "catalog_version": 1,
14	      "harness": "codex",
15	      "runtime_files": [],
16	      "plugins": [{"id": "...", "runtime_files": ["shared/schemas/example@1.json"]}]
17	    }
18	
19	``runtime_files`` may alternatively use ``{"source": "...", "destination":
20	"..."}`` when preserving the repository-relative source path is not appropriate.
21	The output is rebuilt atomically and contains regular files only.  It is a build
22	artifact; do not hand-edit ``dist/codex``.
23	"""
24	
25	from __future__ import annotations
26	
27	import argparse
28	import json
29	import os
30	import re
31	import shutil
32	import sys
33	import tempfile
34	from pathlib import Path
35	from typing import Any
36	
37	
38	CATALOG_VERSION = 1
39	PLUGIN_ID = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$")
40	SEMVER = re.compile(
41	    r"^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)"
42	    r"(?:-(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)(?:\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*)?"
43	    r"(?:\+[0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?$"
44	)
45	
46	
47	class BuildError(Exception):
48	    """A catalog or source input cannot produce a safe marketplace."""
49	
50	
51	def fail(message: str) -> None:
52	    raise BuildError(message)
53	
54	
55	def read_json(path: Path, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
56	    try:
57	        value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
58	    except FileNotFoundError:
59	        fail(f"{label} does not exist: {path}")
60	    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
61	        fail(f"{label} is invalid JSON ({path}:{error.lineno}:{error.colno}): {error.msg}")
62	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
63	        fail(f"{label} must be a JSON object: {path}")
64	    return value
65	
66	
67	def require_string(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
68	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
69	        fail(f"{label} must be a non-empty string")
70	    return value
71	
72	
73	def require_list(value: Any, label: str) -> list[Any]:
74	    if not isinstance(value, list):
75	        fail(f"{label} must be an array")
76	    return value
77	
78	
79	def require_string_list(value: Any, label: str) -> list[str]:
80	    values = require_list(value, label)
81	    if not all(isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in values):
82	        fail(f"{label} must contain non-empty strings")
83	    return values
84	
85	
86	def path_within(root: Path, raw_path: str, label: str) -> Path:
87	    candidate = (root / raw_path).resolve()
88	    try:
89	        candidate.relative_to(root)
90	    except ValueError:
91	        fail(f"{label} escapes the repository root: {raw_path}")
92	    return candidate
93	
94	
95	def output_path(repo_root: Path, raw_path: str) -> Path:
96	    path = (repo_root / raw_path).resolve()
97	    try:
98	        relative = path.relative_to(repo_root)
99	    except ValueError:
100	        fail(f"output path escapes the repository root: {raw_path}")
101	    if not relative.parts:
102	        fail("output path cannot be the repository root")
103	    return path
104	
105	
106	def write_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
107	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
108	    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
109	
110	
111	def write_json_atomically(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
112	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
113	    temporary_path: Path | None = None
114	    try:
115	        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
116	            mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=path.parent, prefix=f".{path.name}.", delete=False
117	        ) as temporary:
118	            temporary.write(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
119	            temporary_path = Path(temporary.name)
120	        temporary_path.replace(path)
121	    finally:
122	        if temporary_path is not None and temporary_path.exists():
123	            temporary_path.unlink()
124	
125	
126	def copy_regular_files(source: Path, destination: Path, repo_root: Path, label: str) -> None:
127	    """Copy a file or directory, resolving links but never emitting one."""
128	    resolved = source.resolve()
129	    try:
130	        resolved.relative_to(repo_root)
131	    except ValueError:
132	        fail(f"{label} resolves outside the repository root: {source}")
133	    if resolved.is_file():
134	        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
135	        shutil.copyfile(resolved, destination)
136	        return
137	    if not resolved.is_dir():
138	        fail(f"{label} is neither a regular file nor a directory: {source}")
139	
140	    for child in sorted(resolved.rglob("*"), key=lambda item: item.as_posix()):
141	        if child.is_dir():
142	            continue
143	        child_resolved = child.resolve()
144	        try:
145	            child_resolved.relative_to(repo_root)
146	        except ValueError:
147	            fail(f"{label} contains a link outside the repository root: {child}")
148	        if not child_resolved.is_file():
149	            fail(f"{label} contains a non-regular file: {child}")
150	        target = destination / child.relative_to(resolved)
151	        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
152	        shutil.copyfile(child_resolved, target)
153	
154	
155	def source_plugin(repo_root: Path, plugin_id: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], set[str]]:
156	    if not PLUGIN_ID.fullmatch(plugin_id):
157	        fail(f"plugins[].id must be a lowercase hyphen-case identifier: {plugin_id!r}")
158	    manifest_path = path_within(repo_root, f"plugins/{plugin_id}/plugin.json", f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest")
159	    manifest = read_json(manifest_path, f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest")
160	    if manifest.get("id") != plugin_id:
161	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest id does not match its catalog id")
162	    version = require_string(manifest.get("version"), f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest.version")
163	    del version
164	    if not isinstance(manifest.get("author"), dict):
165	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest.author must be an object")
166	    skills_root = path_within(repo_root, f"plugins/{plugin_id}/skills", f"plugin {plugin_id} skills")
167	    if not skills_root.is_dir():
168	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} skills directory does not exist: {skills_root}")
169	    skills = {
170	        child.name
171	        for child in skills_root.iterdir()
172	        if child.is_dir() and (child / "SKILL.md").is_file()
173	    }
174	    if not skills:
175	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} has no source skills")
176	    return manifest, skills
177	
178	
179	def native_plugin(repo_root: Path, plugin_id: str) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any], set[str]]:
180	    native_root = path_within(repo_root, f"harnesses/codex/plugins/{plugin_id}", f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id}")
181	    if not native_root.is_dir():
182	        fail(f"native Codex plugin directory does not exist: {native_root}")
183	    manifest_path = path_within(
184	        repo_root,
185	        f"harnesses/codex/plugins/{plugin_id}/.codex-plugin/plugin.json",
186	        f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest",
187	    )
188	    manifest = read_json(manifest_path, f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest")
189	    if require_string(manifest.get("name"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.name") != plugin_id:
190	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest name does not match its catalog id")
191	    version = require_string(manifest.get("version"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.version")
192	    if SEMVER.fullmatch(version) is None:
193	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.version must be strict semver")
194	    require_string(manifest.get("description"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.description")
195	    author = manifest.get("author")
196	    if not isinstance(author, dict):
197	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.author must be an object")
198	    require_string(author.get("name"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.author.name")
199	    if "email" in author:
200	        require_string(author["email"], f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.author.email")
201	    if manifest.get("skills") not in {"skills", "./skills", "skills/", "./skills/"}:
202	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.skills must resolve to skills")
203	    skills_root = path_within(repo_root, f"harnesses/codex/plugins/{plugin_id}/skills", f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} skills")
204	    if not skills_root.is_dir():
205	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} skills directory does not exist: {skills_root}")
206	    skills = {
207	        child.name
208	        for child in skills_root.iterdir()
209	        if child.is_dir() and (child / "SKILL.md").is_file()
210	    }
211	    if not skills:
212	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} has no skills")
213	    interface = manifest.get("interface")
214	    if not isinstance(interface, dict):
215	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.interface must be an object")
216	    for field in ("displayName", "shortDescription", "longDescription", "developerName", "category"):
217	        require_string(interface.get(field), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.interface.{field}")
218	    require_string_list(interface.get("capabilities"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.interface.capabilities")
219	    require_string_list(interface.get("defaultPrompt"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.interface.defaultPrompt")
220	    return native_root, manifest, skills
221	
222	
223	def runtime_entry(entry: Any, repo_root: Path, plugin_output: Path, plugin_id: str) -> None:
224	    if isinstance(entry, str):
225	        source_relative = entry
226	        destination_relative = entry
227	    elif isinstance(entry, dict):
228	        source_relative = require_string(entry.get("source"), f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime_files[].source")
229	        destination_relative = require_string(
230	            entry.get("destination"), f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime_files[].destination"
231	        )
232	    else:
233	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime_files entries must be strings or objects")
234	    source = path_within(repo_root, source_relative, f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime source")
235	    destination = (plugin_output / destination_relative).resolve()
236	    try:
237	        destination.relative_to(plugin_output)
238	    except ValueError:
239	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime destination escapes plugin output: {destination_relative}")
240	    if destination.exists():
241	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime destination conflicts with authored native source: {destination_relative}")
242	    copy_regular_files(source, destination, repo_root, f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime source")
243	
244	
245	def materialize_plugin(
246	    repo_root: Path,
247	    generated_plugins: Path,
248	    entry: dict[str, Any],
249	    global_runtime_files: list[Any],
250	) -> dict[str, Any]:
251	    plugin_id = require_string(entry.get("id"), "plugins[].id")
252	    if not PLUGIN_ID.fullmatch(plugin_id):
253	        fail(f"plugins[].id must be a lowercase hyphen-case identifier: {plugin_id!r}")
254	    source_manifest, source_skills = source_plugin(repo_root, plugin_id)
255	    native_root, native_manifest, native_skills = native_plugin(repo_root, plugin_id)
256	    if native_manifest["version"] != source_manifest["version"]:
257	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} version must match plugins/{plugin_id}/plugin.json")
258	    if native_manifest["author"] != source_manifest["author"]:
259	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} author must match plugins/{plugin_id}/plugin.json")
260	    if native_skills != source_skills:
261	        missing = sorted(source_skills - native_skills)
262	        extra = sorted(native_skills - source_skills)
263	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} skill parity mismatch (missing: {missing}; extra: {extra})")
264	    plugin_output = generated_plugins / plugin_id
265	    copy_regular_files(native_root, plugin_output, repo_root, f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id}")
266	
267	    runtime_files = global_runtime_files + require_list(
268	        entry.get("runtime_files", []), f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime_files"
269	    )
270	    for runtime_file in runtime_files:
271	        runtime_entry(runtime_file, repo_root, plugin_output, plugin_id)
272	
273	    category = require_string(native_manifest["interface"].get("category"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} category")
274	    return {"name": plugin_id, "category": category}
275	
276	
277	def catalog_marketplace(catalog: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
278	    if catalog.get("catalog_version") != CATALOG_VERSION:
279	        fail(f"catalog catalog_version must be {CATALOG_VERSION}")
280	    if catalog.get("harness") != "codex":
281	        fail("catalog harness must be 'codex'")
282	    marketplace = catalog.get("marketplace", {})
283	    if not isinstance(marketplace, dict):
284	        fail("catalog marketplace must be an object when set")
285	    name = marketplace.get("name", "wisp-plugins")
286	    display_name = marketplace.get("display_name", marketplace.get("displayName", "Wisp Plugins"))
287	    return {
288	        "name": require_string(name, "catalog marketplace.name"),
289	        "displayName": require_string(display_name, "catalog marketplace.display_name"),
290	    }
291	
292	
293	def files_match(expected: Path, actual: Path) -> bool:
294	    if not actual.is_dir():
295	        return False
296	    expected_paths = [path.relative_to(expected) for path in expected.rglob("*") if path.is_file()]
297	    if any(path.is_symlink() for path in actual.rglob("*")):
298	        return False
299	    actual_paths = [path.relative_to(actual) for path in actual.rglob("*") if path.is_file()]
300	    if sorted(expected_paths) != sorted(actual_paths):
301	        return False
302	    return all((expected / path).read_bytes() == (actual / path).read_bytes() for path in expected_paths)
303	
304	
305	def file_matches(expected: dict[str, Any], actual: Path) -> bool:
306	    if actual.is_symlink() or not actual.is_file():
307	        return False
308	    return actual.read_bytes() == (json.dumps(expected, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
309	
310	
311	def build(repo_root: Path, catalog_path: Path, output: Path, check: bool = False) -> None:
312	    catalog = read_json(catalog_path, "Codex catalog")
313	    marketplace = catalog_marketplace(catalog)
314	    entries = require_list(catalog.get("plugins"), "catalog plugins")
315	    if not entries:
316	        fail("catalog plugins must not be empty")
317	    if not all(isinstance(entry, dict) for entry in entries):
318	        fail("catalog plugins entries must be objects")
319	    ids = [entry.get("id") for entry in entries]
320	    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
321	        fail("catalog plugins must not repeat an id")
322	    global_runtime_files = require_list(catalog.get("runtime_files", []), "catalog runtime_files")
323	    discovery_manifest = output_path(repo_root, ".agents/plugins/marketplace.json")
324	    output_relative = output.relative_to(repo_root).as_posix()
325	
326	    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
327	    temporary = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{output.name}.build-", dir=output.parent))
328	    backup: Path | None = None
329	    try:
330	        plugins_output = temporary / "plugins"
331	        generated_entries = [
332	            materialize_plugin(repo_root, plugins_output, entry, global_runtime_files) for entry in entries
333	        ]
334	        marketplace_payload = {
335	            "name": marketplace["name"],
336	            "interface": {"displayName": marketplace["displayName"]},
337	            "plugins": [
338	                {
339	                    "name": entry["name"],
340	                    "source": {"source": "local", "path": f"./plugins/{entry['name']}"},
341	                    "policy": {"installation": "AVAILABLE", "authentication": "ON_INSTALL"},
342	                    "category": entry["category"],
343	                }
344	                for entry in generated_entries
345	            ],
346	        }
347	        write_json(temporary / ".agents" / "plugins" / "marketplace.json", marketplace_payload)
348	        discovery_payload = {
349	            **marketplace_payload,
350	            "plugins": [
351	                {
352	                    **entry,
353	                    "source": {
354	                        "source": "local",
355	                        "path": f"./{output_relative}/plugins/{entry['name']}",
356	                    },
357	                }
358	                for entry in marketplace_payload["plugins"]
359	            ],
360	        }
361	
362	        if check:
363	            if not files_match(temporary, output) or not file_matches(discovery_payload, discovery_manifest):
364	                fail(f"generated Codex marketplace is out of date: {output} or {discovery_manifest}")
365	            return
366	
367	        if output.exists() and not output.is_dir():
368	            fail(f"output path exists but is not a directory: {output}")
369	        backup = output.with_name(f".{output.name}.previous-{os.getpid()}")
370	        if backup.exists():
371	            shutil.rmtree(backup)
372	        if output.exists():
373	            output.rename(backup)
374	        temporary.rename(output)
375	        try:
376	            write_json_atomically(discovery_manifest, discovery_payload)
377	        except Exception:
378	            if backup.exists() and output.exists():
379	                shutil.rmtree(output)
380	                backup.rename(output)
381	            raise
382	        if backup.exists():
383	            shutil.rmtree(backup)
384	    except Exception:
385	        if backup is not None and backup.exists() and not output.exists():
386	            backup.rename(output)
387	        raise
388	    finally:
389	        if temporary.exists():
390	            shutil.rmtree(temporary, ignore_errors=True)
391	
392	
393	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
394	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
395	    parser.add_argument("--repo-root", default=".", help="repository root (default: current directory)")
396	    parser.add_argument(
397	        "--catalog", default="harnesses/codex/catalog.json", help="catalog path relative to --repo-root"
398	    )
399	    parser.add_argument("--output", default="dist/codex", help="output path relative to --repo-root")
400	    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="fail if output differs instead of writing it")
401	    arguments = parser.parse_args(argv)
402	    repo_root = Path(arguments.repo_root).resolve()
403	    try:
404	        catalog_path = path_within(repo_root, arguments.catalog, "catalog path")
405	        build(repo_root, catalog_path, output_path(repo_root, arguments.output), arguments.check)
406	    except BuildError as error:
407	        print(f"build-codex-marketplace: error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
408	        return 2
409	    except OSError as error:
410	        print(f"build-codex-marketplace: error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
411	        return 2
412	    return 0
413	
414	
415	if __name__ == "__main__":
416	    raise SystemExit(main())
417

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Block commits that violate generated-output or schema-version invariants."""
3	
4	from __future__ import annotations
5	
6	import json
7	import re
8	import subprocess
9	import sys
10	from pathlib import Path
11	from typing import Any
12	
13	
14	COMMIT_COMMAND = re.compile(r"(?:^|[;&|]\s*)git(?:\s+-[A-Za-z]\s+[^\s;&|]+)*\s+commit(?:\s|$)")
15	REPOSITORY_MARKERS = ("marketplace.json", "shared/constitution.md", "tools/build-codex-marketplace.py")
16	
17	
18	def emit_block(reason: str) -> None:
19	    print(json.dumps({"decision": "block", "reason": reason}))
20	
21	
22	def repository_root(cwd: str) -> Path | None:
23	    try:
24	        result = subprocess.run(
25	            ["git", "-C", cwd, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"],
26	            check=True,
27	            capture_output=True,
28	            text=True,
29	        )
30	    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError):
31	        return None
32	    root = Path(result.stdout.strip())
33	    if all((root / marker).is_file() for marker in REPOSITORY_MARKERS):
34	        return root
35	    return None
36	
37	
38	def is_commit_command(command: str) -> bool:
39	    return bool(COMMIT_COMMAND.search(command))
40	
41	
42	def staged_schema_mutations(root: Path) -> list[str]:
43	    result = subprocess.run(
44	        ["git", "-C", str(root), "diff", "--cached", "--name-status", "--", "shared/schemas"],
45	        check=True,
46	        capture_output=True,
47	        text=True,
48	    )
49	    return [line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line and not line.startswith("A\t")]
50	
51	
52	def generated_bundle_is_current(root: Path) -> bool:
53	    result = subprocess.run(
54	        [sys.executable, "tools/build-codex-marketplace.py", "--check"],
55	        cwd=root,
56	        capture_output=True,
57	        text=True,
58	    )
59	    return result.returncode == 0
60	
61	
62	def evaluate(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
63	    tool_name = payload.get("tool_name")
64	    tool_input = payload.get("tool_input")
65	    if tool_name != "Bash" or not isinstance(tool_input, dict):
66	        return None
67	    command = tool_input.get("command")
68	    cwd = payload.get("cwd")
69	    if not isinstance(command, str) or not is_commit_command(command) or not isinstance(cwd, str):
70	        return None
71	    root = repository_root(cwd)
72	    if root is None:
73	        return None
74	    mutations = staged_schema_mutations(root)
75	    if mutations:
76	        changed = ", ".join(mutations)
77	        return f"Tracked schema versions are immutable. Add a new shared/schemas/<name>@<N+1>.json instead of committing: {changed}"
78	    if not generated_bundle_is_current(root):
79	        return "The generated Codex marketplace is stale. Run python3 tools/build-codex-marketplace.py, review dist/codex, then commit."
80	    return None
81	
82	
83	def main() -> int:
84	    try:
85	        payload = json.load(sys.stdin)
86	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
87	        return 0
88	    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
89	        return 0
90	    reason = evaluate(payload)
91	    if reason:
92	        emit_block(reason)
93	    return 0
94	
95	
96	if __name__ == "__main__":
97	    raise SystemExit(main())
98

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# For each plugin, checks that plugin.json's version, the README's
3	# **Version:** line, the CHANGELOG's top entry, and marketplace.json's
4	# per-plugin version all agree. These four are updated by hand on every
5	# bump and have drifted before (fixed across 4 plugins in v3.1.0) —
6	# nothing structural stopped it from happening again.
7	#
8	# Usage: scripts/check-versions.sh
9	
10	set -euo pipefail
11	script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
12	# shellcheck source=lib/report.sh
13	source "$script_dir/lib/report.sh"
14	cd "$script_dir/.."
15	
16	fail=0
17	count=0
18	
19	for plugin_json in plugins/*/plugin.json; do
20	  dir="$(dirname "$plugin_json")"
21	  id="$(basename "$dir")"
22	  count=$((count + 1))
23	
24	  pj_version="$(jq -r '.version' "$plugin_json")"
25	  readme_version="$(grep -oE '\*\*Version:\*\* *[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$dir/README.md" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
26	  changelog_version="$(grep -oE '^## \[[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$dir/CHANGELOG.md" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
27	  marketplace_version="$(jq -r --arg id "$id" '.plugins[] | select(.id == $id) | .version' marketplace.json)"
28	
29	  mismatches=()
30	  [[ -z "$readme_version" ]] && mismatches+=("README: no **Version:** line found")
31	  [[ -n "$readme_version" && "$readme_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("README says $readme_version")
32	  [[ -z "$changelog_version" ]] && mismatches+=("CHANGELOG: no ## [x.y.z] entry found")
33	  [[ -n "$changelog_version" && "$changelog_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("CHANGELOG says $changelog_version")
34	  [[ -z "$marketplace_version" ]] && mismatches+=("marketplace.json: no entry for id \"$id\"")
35	  [[ -n "$marketplace_version" && "$marketplace_version" != "$pj_version" ]] && mismatches+=("marketplace.json says $marketplace_version")
36	
37	  if [[ ${#mismatches[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
38	    fail=$((fail + 1))
39	    echo "FAIL: $id (plugin.json: $pj_version)"
40	    for m in "${mismatches[@]}"; do
41	      echo "    $m"
42	    done
43	  fi
44	done
45	
46	report_check "$fail" "$count" \
47	  "plugin(s), all versions agree across plugin.json/README/CHANGELOG/marketplace.json." \
48	  "plugin(s) have version drift. Fix and re-run."
49	
50	# The ecosystem-level version has the same drift risk as a plugin's, and the
51	# same nothing structural stopped it: marketplace.json's top-level .version
52	# sat two releases ahead of the root CHANGELOG.md and README badge before
53	# this check existed.
54	root_version="$(jq -r '.version' marketplace.json)"
55	root_changelog_version="$(grep -oE '^## \[[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' CHANGELOG.md | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
56	root_badge_version="$(grep -oE 'Marketplace-v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' README.md | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' || true)"
57	
58	root_mismatches=()
59	[[ -z "$root_changelog_version" ]] && root_mismatches+=("CHANGELOG.md: no ## [x.y.z] entry found")
60	[[ -n "$root_changelog_version" && "$root_changelog_version" != "$root_version" ]] && root_mismatches+=("CHANGELOG.md says $root_changelog_version")
61	[[ -z "$root_badge_version" ]] && root_mismatches+=("README.md: no Marketplace badge found")
62	[[ -n "$root_badge_version" && "$root_badge_version" != "$root_version" ]] && root_mismatches+=("README.md badge says $root_badge_version")
63	
64	root_fail=0
65	if [[ ${#root_mismatches[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
66	  root_fail=1
67	  echo "FAIL: ecosystem version (marketplace.json: $root_version)"
68	  for m in "${root_mismatches[@]}"; do
69	    echo "    $m"
70	  done
71	fi
72	
73	report_check "$root_fail" 1 \
74	  "ecosystem version agrees across marketplace.json/CHANGELOG.md/README.md." \
75	  "ecosystem version has drift. Fix and re-run."
76

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Enforces constitution.md's Progressive Context Loading rule: a reference
3	# file covering mixed concerns must be split before publishing. The hard
4	# 120-line cap catches structural sprawl; the word-count warning catches
5	# dense one-line prose without turning length into an automatic failure.
6	# Checks canonical shared/references/ only; plugin shared paths link here.
7	#
8	# Usage: scripts/check-reference-size.sh
9	
10	set -euo pipefail
11	script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
12	# shellcheck source=lib/report.sh
13	source "$script_dir/lib/report.sh"
14	cd "$script_dir/.."
15	
16	cap=120
17	word_review=800
18	fail=0
19	count=0
20	warnings=0
21	
22	while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
23	  count=$((count + 1))
24	  lines=$(wc -l < "$file" | tr -d ' ')
25	  if [[ "$lines" -gt "$cap" ]]; then
26	    fail=$((fail + 1))
27	    echo "FAIL: $file ($lines lines, cap is $cap) — split by concern"
28	  fi
29	  words=$(wc -w < "$file" | tr -d ' ')
30	  if [[ "$words" -gt "$word_review" ]]; then
31	    warnings=$((warnings + 1))
32	    echo "WARN: $file ($words words) — review for mixed concerns, repetition, and removable examples"
33	  fi
34	done < <(find shared/references -name '*.md' -print0)
35	
36	if [[ "$warnings" -gt 0 ]]; then
37	  echo "WARN: $warnings reference file(s) crossed the review signal; this does not fail validation."
38	fi
39	
40	report_check "$fail" "$count" \
41	  "reference file(s) in shared/references/, all at or under the ${cap}-line cap." \
42	  "reference file(s) exceed the ${cap}-line cap. Split by concern and re-run."
43

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# For each plugin, extracts every `plugin/skill-name` mention from a README
3	# table row (the "| `plugin/skill` | ... |" Skills table every split plugin
4	# uses) and checks a matching skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md exists. Scoped to
5	# table rows, not free prose, so a README that explicitly says "there is no
6	# `plugin/skill` to invoke" (the fix applied in v3.1.0) doesn't false-positive.
7	# Catches skills documented as real but never built or renamed without
8	# updating the docs — five plugins had this fixed in v3.1.0.
9	#
10	# Usage: scripts/check-skills-doc.sh
11	
12	set -euo pipefail
13	script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
14	# shellcheck source=lib/report.sh
15	source "$script_dir/lib/report.sh"
16	cd "$script_dir/.."
17	
18	fail=0
19	count=0
20	
21	for plugin_json in plugins/*/plugin.json; do
22	  dir="$(dirname "$plugin_json")"
23	  id="$(basename "$dir")"
24	  count=$((count + 1))
25	
26	  mentions="$(grep -E "^\| \`${id}/[a-z0-9-]+\`" "$dir/README.md" 2>/dev/null \
27	              | grep -oE "\`${id}/[a-z0-9-]+\`" | tr -d '`' | sort -u || true)"
28	
29	  missing=()
30	  while IFS= read -r mention; do
31	    [[ -z "$mention" ]] && continue
32	    skill="${mention#"${id}"/}"
33	    [[ -f "$dir/skills/$skill/SKILL.md" ]] || missing+=("$mention")
34	  done <<< "$mentions"
35	
36	  if [[ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
37	    fail=$((fail + 1))
38	    echo "FAIL: $id"
39	    for m in "${missing[@]}"; do
40	      echo "    documented but no skills/${m#"${id}"/}/SKILL.md: $m"
41	    done
42	  fi
43	done
44	
45	report_check "$fail" "$count" \
46	  "plugin(s), every documented skill has a matching skills/ directory." \
47	  "plugin(s) document skills with no matching directory. Fix and re-run."
48

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Shared OK/FAILED summary for scripts/check-*.sh — keeps their output in
3	# one consistent shape instead of each script reimplementing it.
4	#
5	# Usage: report_check <fail_count> <total_count> <ok_suffix> <fail_suffix>
6	#   report_check "$fail" "$count" \
7	#     "plugin(s), all versions agree." \
8	#     "plugin(s) have version drift. Fix and re-run."
9	# Prints "OK: $count $ok_suffix" and returns 0, or prints
10	# "FAILED: $fail of $count $fail_suffix" and exits 1.
11	
12	report_check() {
13	  local fail="$1" count="$2" ok_suffix="$3" fail_suffix="$4"
14	  echo ""
15	  if [[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]]; then
16	    echo "OK: $count $ok_suffix"
17	  else
18	    echo "FAILED: $fail of $count $fail_suffix"
19	    exit 1
20	  fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Materialize the repository's authored Codex marketplace.
3	
4	Codex behavior is authored in ``harnesses/codex/plugins/<id>/``.  The builder
5	copies those native plugin trees into ``dist/codex`` without rewriting manifests
6	or skills. It also emits the repository-root discovery manifest at
7	``.agents/plugins/marketplace.json``; that manifest points at the generated
8	bundle for Git marketplace installation. ``harnesses/codex/catalog.json``
9	controls marketplace identity, order, and portable runtime files only. Its
10	supported shape is::
11	
12	    {
13	      "catalog_version": 1,
14	      "harness": "codex",
15	      "runtime_files": [],
16	      "plugins": [{"id": "...", "runtime_files": ["shared/schemas/example@1.json"]}]
17	    }
18	
19	``runtime_files`` may alternatively use ``{"source": "...", "destination":
20	"..."}`` when preserving the repository-relative source path is not appropriate.
21	The output is rebuilt atomically and contains regular files only.  It is a build
22	artifact; do not hand-edit ``dist/codex``.
23	"""
24

39	PLUGIN_ID = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$")
40	SEMVER = re.compile(
41	    r"^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)"
42	    r"(?:-(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)(?:\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*)?"
43	    r"(?:\+[0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?$"
44	)

55	def read_json(path: Path, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
56	    try:
57	        value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
58	    except FileNotFoundError:
59	        fail(f"{label} does not exist: {path}")
60	    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
61	        fail(f"{label} is invalid JSON ({path}:{error.lineno}:{error.colno}): {error.msg}")
62	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
63	        fail(f"{label} must be a JSON object: {path}")
64	    return value

106	def write_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
107	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
108	    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

111	def write_json_atomically(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
112	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
113	    temporary_path: Path | None = None
114	    try:
115	        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
116	            mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=path.parent, prefix=f".{path.name}.", delete=False
117	        ) as temporary:
118	            temporary.write(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
119	            temporary_path = Path(temporary.name)
120	        temporary_path.replace(path)
121	    finally:
122	        if temporary_path is not None and temporary_path.exists():
123	            temporary_path.unlink()

126	def copy_regular_files(source: Path, destination: Path, repo_root: Path, label: str) -> None:
127	    """Copy a file or directory, resolving links but never emitting one."""
128	    resolved = source.resolve()
129	    try:
130	        resolved.relative_to(repo_root)
131	    except ValueError:
132	        fail(f"{label} resolves outside the repository root: {source}")
133	    if resolved.is_file():
134	        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
135	        shutil.copyfile(resolved, destination)
136	        return
137	    if not resolved.is_dir():
138	        fail(f"{label} is neither a regular file nor a directory: {source}")
139	
140	    for child in sorted(resolved.rglob("*"), key=lambda item: item.as_posix()):
141	        if child.is_dir():
142	            continue
143	        child_resolved = child.resolve()
144	        try:
145	            child_resolved.relative_to(repo_root)
146	        except ValueError:
147	            fail(f"{label} contains a link outside the repository root: {child}")
148	        if not child_resolved.is_file():
149	            fail(f"{label} contains a non-regular file: {child}")
150	        target = destination / child.relative_to(resolved)
151	        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
152	        shutil.copyfile(child_resolved, target)

155	def source_plugin(repo_root: Path, plugin_id: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], set[str]]:
156	    if not PLUGIN_ID.fullmatch(plugin_id):
157	        fail(f"plugins[].id must be a lowercase hyphen-case identifier: {plugin_id!r}")
158	    manifest_path = path_within(repo_root, f"plugins/{plugin_id}/plugin.json", f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest")
159	    manifest = read_json(manifest_path, f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest")
160	    if manifest.get("id") != plugin_id:
161	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest id does not match its catalog id")
162	    version = require_string(manifest.get("version"), f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest.version")
163	    del version
164	    if not isinstance(manifest.get("author"), dict):
165	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} manifest.author must be an object")
166	    skills_root = path_within(repo_root, f"plugins/{plugin_id}/skills", f"plugin {plugin_id} skills")
167	    if not skills_root.is_dir():
168	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} skills directory does not exist: {skills_root}")
169	    skills = {
170	        child.name
171	        for child in skills_root.iterdir()
172	        if child.is_dir() and (child / "SKILL.md").is_file()
173	    }
174	    if not skills:
175	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} has no source skills")
176	    return manifest, skills

179	def native_plugin(repo_root: Path, plugin_id: str) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Any], set[str]]:
180	    native_root = path_within(repo_root, f"harnesses/codex/plugins/{plugin_id}", f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id}")
181	    if not native_root.is_dir():
182	        fail(f"native Codex plugin directory does not exist: {native_root}")
183	    manifest_path = path_within(
184	        repo_root,
185	        f"harnesses/codex/plugins/{plugin_id}/.codex-plugin/plugin.json",
186	        f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest",
187	    )
188	    manifest = read_json(manifest_path, f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest")
189	    if require_string(manifest.get("name"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.name") != plugin_id:
190	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest name does not match its catalog id")
191	    version = require_string(manifest.get("version"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.version")
192	    if SEMVER.fullmatch(version) is None:
193	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.version must be strict semver")
194	    require_string(manifest.get("description"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.description")
195	    author = manifest.get("author")
196	    if not isinstance(author, dict):
197	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.author must be an object")
198	    require_string(author.get("name"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.author.name")
199	    if "email" in author:
200	        require_string(author["email"], f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.author.email")
201	    if manifest.get("skills") not in {"skills", "./skills", "skills/", "./skills/"}:
202	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.skills must resolve to skills")
203	    skills_root = path_within(repo_root, f"harnesses/codex/plugins/{plugin_id}/skills", f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} skills")
204	    if not skills_root.is_dir():
205	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} skills directory does not exist: {skills_root}")
206	    skills = {
207	        child.name
208	        for child in skills_root.iterdir()
209	        if child.is_dir() and (child / "SKILL.md").is_file()
210	    }
211	    if not skills:
212	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} has no skills")
213	    interface = manifest.get("interface")
214	    if not isinstance(interface, dict):
215	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.interface must be an object")
216	    for field in ("displayName", "shortDescription", "longDescription", "developerName", "category"):
217	        require_string(interface.get(field), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.interface.{field}")
218	    require_string_list(interface.get("capabilities"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.interface.capabilities")
219	    require_string_list(interface.get("defaultPrompt"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} manifest.interface.defaultPrompt")
220	    return native_root, manifest, skills

223	def runtime_entry(entry: Any, repo_root: Path, plugin_output: Path, plugin_id: str) -> None:
224	    if isinstance(entry, str):
225	        source_relative = entry
226	        destination_relative = entry
227	    elif isinstance(entry, dict):
228	        source_relative = require_string(entry.get("source"), f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime_files[].source")
229	        destination_relative = require_string(
230	            entry.get("destination"), f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime_files[].destination"
231	        )
232	    else:
233	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime_files entries must be strings or objects")
234	    source = path_within(repo_root, source_relative, f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime source")
235	    destination = (plugin_output / destination_relative).resolve()
236	    try:
237	        destination.relative_to(plugin_output)
238	    except ValueError:
239	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime destination escapes plugin output: {destination_relative}")
240	    if destination.exists():
241	        fail(f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime destination conflicts with authored native source: {destination_relative}")
242	    copy_regular_files(source, destination, repo_root, f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime source")

245	def materialize_plugin(
246	    repo_root: Path,
247	    generated_plugins: Path,
248	    entry: dict[str, Any],
249	    global_runtime_files: list[Any],
250	) -> dict[str, Any]:
251	    plugin_id = require_string(entry.get("id"), "plugins[].id")
252	    if not PLUGIN_ID.fullmatch(plugin_id):
253	        fail(f"plugins[].id must be a lowercase hyphen-case identifier: {plugin_id!r}")
254	    source_manifest, source_skills = source_plugin(repo_root, plugin_id)
255	    native_root, native_manifest, native_skills = native_plugin(repo_root, plugin_id)
256	    if native_manifest["version"] != source_manifest["version"]:
257	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} version must match plugins/{plugin_id}/plugin.json")
258	    if native_manifest["author"] != source_manifest["author"]:
259	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} author must match plugins/{plugin_id}/plugin.json")
260	    if native_skills != source_skills:
261	        missing = sorted(source_skills - native_skills)
262	        extra = sorted(native_skills - source_skills)
263	        fail(f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} skill parity mismatch (missing: {missing}; extra: {extra})")
264	    plugin_output = generated_plugins / plugin_id
265	    copy_regular_files(native_root, plugin_output, repo_root, f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id}")
266	
267	    runtime_files = global_runtime_files + require_list(
268	        entry.get("runtime_files", []), f"plugin {plugin_id} runtime_files"
269	    )
270	    for runtime_file in runtime_files:
271	        runtime_entry(runtime_file, repo_root, plugin_output, plugin_id)
272	
273	    category = require_string(native_manifest["interface"].get("category"), f"native Codex plugin {plugin_id} category")
274	    return {"name": plugin_id, "category": category}

277	def catalog_marketplace(catalog: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
278	    if catalog.get("catalog_version") != CATALOG_VERSION:
279	        fail(f"catalog catalog_version must be {CATALOG_VERSION}")
280	    if catalog.get("harness") != "codex":
281	        fail("catalog harness must be 'codex'")
282	    marketplace = catalog.get("marketplace", {})
283	    if not isinstance(marketplace, dict):
284	        fail("catalog marketplace must be an object when set")
285	    name = marketplace.get("name", "wisp-plugins")
286	    display_name = marketplace.get("display_name", marketplace.get("displayName", "Wisp Plugins"))
287	    return {
288	        "name": require_string(name, "catalog marketplace.name"),
289	        "displayName": require_string(display_name, "catalog marketplace.display_name"),
290	    }

293	def files_match(expected: Path, actual: Path) -> bool:
294	    if not actual.is_dir():
295	        return False
296	    expected_paths = [path.relative_to(expected) for path in expected.rglob("*") if path.is_file()]
297	    if any(path.is_symlink() for path in actual.rglob("*")):
298	        return False
299	    actual_paths = [path.relative_to(actual) for path in actual.rglob("*") if path.is_file()]
300	    if sorted(expected_paths) != sorted(actual_paths):
301	        return False
302	    return all((expected / path).read_bytes() == (actual / path).read_bytes() for path in expected_paths)
303	
304	
305	def file_matches(expected: dict[str, Any], actual: Path) -> bool:
306	    if actual.is_symlink() or not actual.is_file():
307	        return False
308	    return actual.read_bytes() == (json.dumps(expected, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
